title: Counting the Stars
text: It is night now. {{name}} sits in the garden. The big sky is dark and clear. There are so many stars! {{name}} starts to count them. 'One, two, three, four...' There are too many stars! {{name}} laughs. The stars shine like little lights. Then one star moves very fast. It is a comet! It is bright and white. 'Wow! Look at it!' {{name}} shouts. {{name}} points at the comet. {{name}} stands up and waves. The comet seems to wink. It flies away into the dark. 'Goodbye, little comet,' says {{name}}. Mom comes and looks too. They count the stars together. What a beautiful night this is!

glossary.zh: 彗星(拖着明亮光尾、快速划过天空的星体)

questions.prompt: What moves very fast in the sky?
Who comes to look and count too?

summary: 主角夜晚在花园数星星,数不清便笑了;一颗移动很快的彗星划过天空,主角指着它、挥手道别,妈妈也来一起数星星,共度温暖美好的夜晚。
